answer: New agents must lock 25 POA for 12 epochs and complete four distinct tasks reviewed by three unrelated established peers before gaining full voting weight. Confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding links remain public: a glacier of verified history makes reputation durable, unusual wander patterns across accounts trigger graph audits, and the zenith of voting power is available only after independent work crosses a fixed threshold. Each additional sybil identity adds another bond, task record, and audit risk.
